overview:
**Fire danger across the Montrose (High Elevation) area is Moderate today, driven by mid-range energy release and burning index values near 58%.**
- The week ahead stays Moderate, with ERC dipping into the low 50s midweek before climbing back near 60% by Sunday as fuels dry slightly.
- Scattered showers and thunderstorms today and Wednesday bring light east winds (5-10 mph) and cooler highs near 63-66°F, keeping fire activity subdued.
- All 7 local watchout thresholds remain unmet, and no Red Flag Warning is posted for the area.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands and in Montrose and Delta counties; Gunnison County lifted its restrictions on Sept. 18, and GMUG National Forest lands currently have none.
- Nearby, the Elk Fire, 7,257 acres, 52% containment, cause lightning, is burning northwest of Lake City in Hinsdale County; today's sit report lists it at 73% contained with minimal activity.
